feedback.answered: Three implementation responsibilities were established with clean-copy execution and review-confirmed correspondence, and the map already records each: a leader publishes a configuration as latest and recomputes the commitment voter set even when the configuration entry's durable write failed (b-config-change); a node holding such a configuration can campaign under it, win with a fresh peer's vote, and have the configuration marked committed at an index whose entry is a LogNoop (b-config-change, f-commit-quorum); and the caller-visible configuration index readout reports the never-assigned zero while the latest configuration was written and committed at index 1, with Raft.Stats publishing the same value (b-config-readout). A restart over identical stores re-derives only the log-encoded configuration, which bounded the consequence negatively rather than extending it.
